feature_pool_definition: Intersection of the 44 primary ECM DEGs and non-grey genes assigned by dynamic WGCNA

selection_method.LASSO: LogisticRegressionCV; L1; liblinear; 5-fold CV; Cs=[0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5,1,5,10]; selected |coef| > 1e-4
selection_method.SVM_RFE: Linear SVC recursive elimination; top 10 features; step=1
selection_method.Random_Forest: 500 trees; balanced class weights; top 10 importance threshold (ties included)

performance_note: Feature selection used the full discovery cohort. These outputs do not estimate out-of-sample performance; that requires feature selection nested inside cross-validation.
